name: Burger, Simple
body:
Station and Complexity grillardin 2, line cook 2

Flavor Profiles texture, umami
Additional Ingredients bitter, salty, sour, spicy, or umami

EFFECT

Duration 1 minute/level; Serving Size 1
Saving Throw none (harmless); Spell Resistance no (harmless)

DESCRIPTION

A simple burger is a round piece of grilled minced meat between two slices of bread, with various raw or cooked vegetables as toppings and sauces to taste. It’s a meal fit for someone who is in a hurry.

When consumed, it grants an expeditious retreat effect, as the spell, for the duration.

Additional sour or spicy ingredients add an additional +5 ft. of speed each.

Additional bitter, salty, or umami ingredients increase the serving size by +1 each.
